name: Grounded Editorial - current tokens
status: Current native component contracts aligned; real-device accessibility validation remains a release check

semanticNotes: Light appearance uses an off-white canvas with darker warm stone surfaces, matching the screen studies.
Brand/accent colours do not encode mood quality.
History fill is not a clinical safe range.
Select, warning and error require text/icon indicators and independent contrast verification.
The warm charcoal/sage dark mapping replaces the initial blue-grey palette. Use exact tokens and native charts, not raster colour sampling.

surfaceRaised is the resting fill for controls that sit on a card (choices, option rows, header action circles). surfaceSunk is reserved for transient presses carrying primary ink. Rows with metadata use rowPressed, aliased to surfaceRaised, so muted text remains readable. Muted text may rest on surfaceRaised but never on surfaceSunk.

Standalone cards, including the Body lead measurement and Life wheel, use surface without a border. Featured invitations use featured/onFeatured with a featuredBorder outline in dark appearance. Continuous lists use dividers instead of a surface per record.

Secondary buttons use canvas with a strong interactiveBorder outline and neutral ink in both appearances. The featured Journal check-in card and Intake invitation share an inset cardAction/onCardAction cue: stone with brand text in light, sage with dark ink in dark; the whole card is the action.

Factor chips and segmented controls use selected/onSelected: soft teal with brand ink in light, sage with dark ink in dark. selectedSoft remains the subtle fill for option rows, status and switch tracks.

terminology.Heading: Retained in this visual pass
terminology.Life review: Use existing configured areas and scale

components.name: AppScaffold
components.contract: Safe areas, scroll container and stable tab/action placement.

components.name: ScreenHeader
components.contract: Centred uppercase 12/16 medium sans navigation titles on sub-screens and full-height forms; no native large-title expansion. Main tabs retain editorial titles; step flows retain progress headers. Back/close and contextual actions keep their behavior.

components.name: DateStrip
components.contract: Selected date and recorded-entry indicators are independent.

components.name: BottomNavigation
components.contract: Journal / Intake / Body / Life; icon plus visible label.

components.name: LogAction
components.contract: Labelled + Log; destination-aware options preserve the active date.

components.name: Button
components.contract: Pill buttons, minimum height 52, medium 14/20 labels. Secondary uses canvas, a strong outline and neutral ink. Primary, text, destructive, loading and disabled states; quiet navigation uses TextAction.

components.name: IconButton
components.contract: Named action, minimum hit area and distinct selected/pressed state.

components.name: SelectableRow
components.contract: Equal height; no default answer; explicit selection.

components.name: FactorChip
components.usedBy: Journal factors, Intake filters, habit areas and weekdays
components.contract: Wrapping choices with readable labels, selected checkmarks and at least 48-point touch targets. Preserve optional and multiple selection where supported.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.usedBy: Body and Insights ranges, Intake day tabs and item types
components.contract: Fixed single-value choices use radios; content switches use tabs. Share FactorChip’s 40-point minimum visual height inside 48-point touch targets, growing with text. Announce selection and disabled states.

components.name: FormField
components.contract: Persistent label, input, helper, optionality and inline error.

components.name: QuantityField
components.contract: Numeric value, unit metadata, direct input and optional step. Measurement and Intake quantity inputs use 18/22 semibold tabular sans, including compound units.

components.name: DetailRow
components.contract: Label/value pair, optional source/date and disclosure action. Layout, fill, density and separators are independent; continuous lists use dividers and omit the final separator. Metadata rows press on surfaceRaised.

components.name: FeedbackBanner
components.contract: Outcome, scope and one relevant action such as Undo or Retry.

components.name: CheckInCard
components.contract: Not started, partial, complete; event time and human labels. The whole card is tappable; the featured card uses a decorative cardAction/onCardAction cue.

components.name: CheckInStepper
components.contract: Step count, draft retention and distinct continue/save actions.

components.name: IntakeRow
components.contract: Item, visible amount/unit and contextual repeat/edit action.

components.name: SourceStamp
components.contract: Origin, measurement time and optional separate sync time.

components.name: MeasurementCard
components.contract: Complete value/unit, event time, range and comparison basis. The Body lead card uses the same borderless surface as the Life wheel card.

components.name: RecentRange
components.contract: Neutral interval with window, method and sufficient-data state.

components.name: TrendChart
components.contract: Labelled axes/units, gaps, selected reading and text alternative.

components.name: LifeWheel
components.contract: Stable area IDs/order, configured scale, two review styles. The Life overview wheel sits on the shared borderless card surface.

components.name: LifeAreaRow
components.contract: Named area/value, scale, previous value and missing state.

components.name: HeadingCard
components.contract: Status, title, intent/target, dates and detail/edit action.

components.name: PracticeRow
components.contract: Action, completion/event reference and optional amount/time.

components.name: ReadingsList
components.contract: Exact recorded values, timestamps, units and sources.

components.name: ManagementRow
components.contract: Visibility, reorder and labels; deletion is separate.

components.name: ActionSheet
components.usedBy: + Log, settings, units and contextual actions
components.contract: Shared sans title and spacing, named options, date context and keyboard handling. Single choices dismiss on selection; multiple choices offer Done. Effective default units are visibly selected and identified.

screens.name: Journal overview
screens.coverage: Calendar, AM/PM cards, grouped factors, add action.

screens.name: Mood check-in
screens.coverage: Existing five mood words, equal options, progress and save.

screens.name: Energy check-in
screens.coverage: Shared selection component; scale labels need confirmation.

screens.name: Motivation check-in
screens.coverage: Shared selection component and complete/partial save.

screens.name: Intake overview
screens.coverage: Daily entries, timestamps and a direct logging action.

screens.name: Search and recents
screens.coverage: Food/drink filters, suggestions and Something else.

screens.name: Item amount
screens.coverage: Amount, units, date/time and nutrition disclosure.

screens.name: Custom item
screens.coverage: Name, type, amount, optional details and reuse choice.

screens.name: Body overview
screens.coverage: Lead measurement, personal history and measurement list.

screens.name: Measurement detail
screens.coverage: Source, range, readings, Heading and history.

screens.name: Add reading
screens.coverage: Metric, numeric value, units, event time and note.

screens.name: Manage measurements
screens.coverage: Visibility, ordering, custom metric and display units.

screens.name: Life overview
screens.coverage: Review date, wheel, manage areas and Headings.

screens.name: Review detail
screens.coverage: Named life-area values and previous-review comparison.

screens.name: Edit Heading
screens.coverage: Name, intent, life area, dates and optional reason.

dataContracts.moodLabels: Preserve current labels and scale versions
dataContracts.energyMotivationLabels: Proposed labels in PoC; verify existing meaning before mapping saved values
dataContracts.personalRange: Preserve existing middle-half definition and calculation convention; show period, method and valid count
dataContracts.lifeWheel: Read area IDs/order/labels and scale from configuration; do not use illustrative names as defaults
dataContracts.nutritionBasis: Explicitly state per-quantity, per-100g/ml or per-serving basis; unknown is not zero
dataContracts.units: Metric- and item-specific conversions; do not silently equate mass and volume
dataContracts.draftSelection: No default answer in a fresh check-in
dataContracts.recordIdentity: Keep IDs stable across edits, retries and views

appearance.preferenceStorage: Persist per device; resolve before first app frame
appearance.systemChanges: Follow only while preference is system
appearance.coverage: Apply both appearances to all 28 component contracts and all 16 screen layouts
